To convert the weight of the steer from kilograms to pounds, we use the given conversion factor: 1 pound is approximately equal to 0.4536 kilograms.

Step 1: Identify the weight of the steer in kilograms.
The weight of the steer is given as 200 kilograms.

Step 2: Identify the conversion factor.
The conversion factor is 1 pound = 0.4536 kilograms.

Step 3: Set up the conversion.
To convert kilograms to pounds, we divide the weight in kilograms by the conversion factor.
\[ \text{Weight in pounds} = \frac{200 \text{ kg}}{0.4536 \text{ kg/pound}} \]

Step 4: Perform the division.
\[ \frac{200}{0.4536} \approx 440.924 \]

Step 5: Round the result to the nearest whole number.
Rounding 440.924 to the nearest whole number gives us 441.

Therefore, the weight of the steer is \boxed{441} pounds.
